plan.title: Auction Publish Blocked Without Closing Mode

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event as a buy auction while leaving closing mode unset; no catalog step sets closing mode.
Provide the mandatory event title for the otherwise valid create flow.
Select the first available auction template; the catalog cannot identify a specific reverse-auction template without its name.
Add the requested product and quantity; plant location cannot be set by this step.
Complete the auction pricing sheet so the missing closing mode is the deliberate publish precondition failure.
Add two QA vendors to match the two vendor selections in the case.
Press Publish Event and assert that Procol refuses publication specifically because closing mode was not selected.
